# Time-off policy 2026 (personal summary)

PTO (paid time off) — the company's single pool of paid leave days that covers vacation and personal days; sick leave is separate.

- Yearly allowance: 24 PTO days.
- Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year; the rest expires on 31 March.
- PTO requests go to the team lead at least two weeks ahead.

Balance on 2026-10-01: **9 PTO days** left for 2026.
